en: The postcard is a collage of four images depicting a picturesque mountainous village. The top left image shows a building labeled 'RISTORANTE' with red shutters, a car parked outside, and cobblestone streets. The top right image features a panoramic view of a village nestled in green hills. The bottom left image is a close-up of blooming red-pink flowers. The bottom right image shows another view of the village, with a church featuring a bell tower and more traditional buildings amid lush greenery and mountains.
